section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations

propositions.proposition: 英国退出欧盟及EEA后，不再有义务继续遵循欧盟反洗钱指令，但作为FATF成员国，需实施符合FATF标准的立法。
source_quotes: Because it is not part of the EU or the EEA, the UK is not obligated to continue following the EU AMLDs, most recently the 6AMLD. In the current landscape, the UK remains a member of FATF and implements legislation that meets FATF’s AML/CFT global standards.

trigger_or_context: 英国于2020年1月退出欧盟并不属于欧盟或欧洲经济区
basis_or_condition: 英国不再是欧盟/欧洲经济区成员
英国仍是金融行动特别工作组（FATF）成员
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 英国在反洗钱/反恐融资方面的法律义务发生变化
outcomes_or_paths: 不再遵循欧盟反洗钱指令（如6AMLD）
实施符合FATF全球标准的立法

evidence_spans.quote: Because it is not part of the EU or the EEA, the UK is not obligated to continue following the EU AMLDs, most recently the 6AMLD. In the current landscape, the UK remains a member of FATF and implements legislation that meets FATF’s AML/CFT global standards.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: S1.1未生成任何候选，因此未承接英国脱欧后反洗钱法律义务从遵循EU AMLDs转向实施FATF标准这一核心法律适用判断链。
